content.title: Arvada Liquor Licensing Authority
content.summary: The Arvada Liquor Licensing Authority is responsible for reviewing new liquor license applications, overseeing renewals, and handling hearings related to liquor code violations. Meetings are held at 10:00 AM on the 2nd and 4th Mondays of each month in the Council Chambers at City Hall, located at 8101 Ralston Road.
content.body:
## Overview

Arvada's Liquor Licensing Authority considers new applications for liquor licenses, oversees renewals and other administrative tasks, and conducts hearings on alleged violations of the liquor code.

## Meeting Information

- 10:00 AM
- 2nd and 4th Mondays of every month
- Council Chambers  
  City Hall  
  8101 Ralston Road
